profile.name: Burak Şahin
profile.summary: HR specialist with 4 years in retail, covering recruitment, onboarding and personnel administration for store teams.

descriptions: Recruited and onboarded 120+ store staff per year across 14 stores
Kept personnel files and employment contracts up to date in line with Turkish Labour Law
Collected monthly attendance records from store managers and sent payroll inputs to the accounting firm
Worked on the annual engagement survey with the HR manager
Prepared headcount and turnover reports in Excel
Managed shift schedules for a team of 9
Handled customer complaints and daily cash reconciliation

educations.degree: BA Labour Economics and Industrial Relations
